plain: Ownership of land outright, for life or forever

webster.text: That land or tenement which is held in fee-simple, fee-tail, or for term of life.

example.quote: To this qualification on the part of the county representatives is added another on the part of the county electors, which restrains the right of suffrage to persons having a freehold estate of the annual value of more than twenty pounds sterling, according to the present rate of money.
